title: Add deck archetype/strategy context to blunder annotation prompts
description:
The blunder annotator sees format and player names but no information about each deck's strategy (aggro/control/combo/midrange). This matters for evaluating strategic decisions: a control deck passing priority to hold up counters is correct, while an aggro deck doing the same is often a blunder. The play/draw decision is also archetype-dependent.

For Standard/Modern, decks are all WotC starter decks, so we could potentially pull strategy descriptions from official WotC sources or write them manually. For Commander gauntlet configs, decks are also precons but more varied.

Ideal output: a 1-2 sentence strategy summary per deck included in the Game Overview section of the blunder prompt (e.g. "Deck archetype: UW Control — win by answering threats and grinding card advantage").

This is nontrivial for commander decks since we'd need to either manually write summaries for each precon or generate them from the decklist.
